{{Top|leg}}
'''Kloon''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. On the entry for the [[PCW-880]] [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]], Kloon warned other subscribers that [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo Transportation]] was coating their airlocks with a heat-sensitive contact explosive. The result being that when a fusioncutter was used on them, it ignited a [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] flame that incinerated anything inside ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
